name: Amazon CloudFront - Latency Monitoring
description: See information about latency like longest latency by geographical location, Outlier for average latency time, Average latency time by edge nodes,Average latency time by region and global latency time.
title: Amazon CloudFront - Latency Monitoring

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{AccessLogsdatasource}}   
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid
| parse regex field = requestid "(?<time_taken>\d{1,3}\.\d\d\d)\t"
| timeslice 5m
| fillmissing timeslice(5m)
|where cs_host matches "{{cs_host}}" AND user_agent matches "{{user_agent}}" AND time_taken matches "{{time_taken}}" AND edgeresult matches "{{edgeresult}}" AND edgeloc matches "{{edgeloc}}" AND c_ip matches "{{c_ip}}"
|avg(time_taken) as avg_time_taken by _timeslice
| outlier avg_time_taken threshold=5, window=12, direction=+

panels.title: Average Latency Time in Seconds  by Region

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{AccessLogsdatasource}}   
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid
| parse regex field = requestid "(?<time_taken>\d{1,3}\.\d\d\d)\t"
| if ( edgeloc matches "*IAD*" or edgeloc matches "*DFW*" or edgeloc matches "*JAX*" or edgeloc matches "*LAX*" or edgeloc matches "*MIA*" or edgeloc matches "*JFK*" or edgeloc matches "*EWR*" or edgeloc matches "*SFO*" or edgeloc matches "*SEA*" or edgeloc matches "*IND*" or edgeloc matches "*STL*" or edgeloc matches "*ATL*" or edgeloc matches "*ORD*", "USA", "") as region
| if ( edgeloc matches "*AMS*" or edgeloc matches "*DUB*" or edgeloc matches "*FRA*" or edgeloc matches "*LHR*" or edgeloc matches "*MXP*" or edgeloc matches "*CDG*" or edgeloc matches "*ARN*" or  edgeloc matches "*MUC*", "EUROPE", region) as region
| if ( edgeloc matches "*HGK*" or edgeloc matches "*NRT*" or edgeloc matches "*SIN*", "Asia", region) as region
| if ( edgeloc matches "*GRU*", "South America", region) as region
| if (region == "","Other",region) as region
|where cs_host matches "{{cs_host}}" AND user_agent matches "{{user_agent}}" AND time_taken matches "{{time_taken}}" AND edgeresult matches "{{edgeresult}}" AND edgeloc matches "{{edgeloc}}" AND c_ip matches "{{c_ip}}"
|avg(time_taken) as avg_time_taken by region

| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid
| parse regex field = requestid "(?<time_taken>\d{1,3}\.\d\d\d)\t"
| timeslice 1h
|where cs_host matches "{{cs_host}}" AND user_agent matches "{{user_agent}}" AND time_taken matches "{{time_taken}}" AND edgeresult matches "{{edgeresult}}" AND edgeloc matches "{{edgeloc}}" AND c_ip matches "{{c_ip}}"
|avg(time_taken) as avg_time_taken by _timeslice, edgeloc
| outlier avg_time_taken by edgeloc  threshold=5, window=12 , direction =+
| where avg_time_taken_violation = 1

panels.title: A lower time indicates faster performance in the panels below.
CloudFront Latency - Time_taken
panels.text:
Time_taken: The number of seconds between the time that a CloudFront edge server receives a viewer's request and the time that CloudFront writes the last byte of the response to the edge server's output queue as measured on the server. From the perspective of the viewer, the total time to get the full object will be longer than this value due to network latency and TCP buffering.

AWS Documentation here: http://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudFront/latest/DeveloperGuide/AccessLogs.html#LogFileFormat
